path_policy: All repository paths are POSIX-style and relative to the repository root. External source locations are intentionally not persisted.

authority_tiers.label: Canonical doctrine
authority_tiers.description: Foundational Astro*Carto*Graphy doctrine. Conflicts are resolved in favor of this tier unless a documented product policy explicitly preserves a variant.

authority_tiers.label: Secondary practitioner
authority_tiers.description: Later practitioner synthesis useful for workflow, variants, and cautions, but not a replacement for the canonical source.

authority_tiers.label: Tertiary explainer
authority_tiers.description: Recent explanatory material useful for plain-language comparison only. It cannot establish canonical technique or comparative strength.

authority_tiers.label: Terminology only
authority_tiers.description: Generic astrology vocabulary. Retrieval must be restricted to terminology and must not be treated as astrocartography doctrine.

authority_tiers.label: Excluded from astrocartography retrieval
authority_tiers.description: Material outside astrocartography doctrine. It remains inventoried for provenance but is not indexed into the astrocartography knowledge base.

claim_classifications.description: A faithful, page-located report of what a named source states. It does not imply scientific validation.
A transparent interpretation combining two or more located sources. It must not be presented as a quotation or recovered formula.
A compatibility or feature-family choice inferred from legacy artifacts. It is product parity evidence, not astrological doctrine.
A Vox Stella hypothesis or product policy that requires independent validation and must be labeled accordingly.

bibliography.title: The Astro*Carto*Graphy Book of Maps: The Astrology of Relocation — How 136 Famous People Found Their Places

sources.role: Foundational doctrine and historical case-study atlas
sources.preferred_use: Use first for canonical line, angle, crossing, natal-condition, and remote-activation doctrine. Treat retrospective cases as illustrations, not independent validation.

authority.rationale: Jim Lewis originated the named Astro*Carto*Graphy system; this local book is the primary doctrinal source in the corpus.

retrieval.limitations: Case narratives are retrospective and sometimes use disputed birth times selected partly by map fit.

rights.notes: All rights reserved; repository extraction is retained as an internal research source.
